reasons.customer-app.jpg: FABRICATED APP INTERFACE. It showed a phone displaying an invented UI that has never existed in any ZAYA build, in the customer role pane, under the 'Built — in device testing' pill, captioned 'A customer comparing local choices with ZAYA'. A generated picture of a product presented as evidence that the product exists. Removed unconditionally — not relabelled.
reasons.all_eight: VISIBLE THIRD-PARTY TRADEMARKS. The previous version of this file recorded the exposure itself, verbatim: "Trademark exposure (Coca-Cola cooler in storefront hero; Nestlé 'Nido' in customer-app.jpg) reviewed and ACCEPTED by the founder 2026-07-08; proceeding with these images for the pilot." An 'Illustration' label answers 'is this a photograph?'. It does not answer 'may we publish Coca-Cola's and Nestlé's marks in our advertising?'. A relabel therefore leaves the exposure exactly where it was.
reasons.storefront.jpg: Additionally invents a lit 'ZAYA MINI MARKET' shopfront that does not exist, and was captioned as a 'ZAYA-powered' shop.
